other_conditions: All landholding farmers' families, Self Help Groups (SHGs), User Groups, Cooperative Societies, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and Entrepreneurs are eligible
Applicant must be a native of India
Preference is given to women farmers
Applicant must not have previously received subsidy from any other central scheme
benefits_summary: Provides a 50‑80 % subsidy for purchase of agricultural machinery to financially weak and small/marginal farmers, with priority given to women farmers.
